title: Mandate 82 wording: a late worktree saves its work once, then is refused until it merges
goal: Vision: V-7. The workflow tool lets a worktree that is more than ten minutes behind make one commit to save its work and refuses every commit after it until it has merged, because the tool's merge commands need a worktree with nothing uncommitted. Make the constitution entry, docs/ceo-mandate-82.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and the Mandate 74 cross-reference say exactly that.
